verdict.rationale: Munito AI's docs state that it supports the OpenAI Chat Completions API (plus the Responses and Anthropic Messages APIs), and that migrating from the OpenAI SDK only requires changing the base URL, key and model ID. An agent can therefore switch to or away from it without provider-specific code. A live llms.txt probe lists OpenAI base URLs, and an OpenAPI contract is published; tool calls, streaming and structured outputs are documented, along with connections for Codex, OpenCode and LangChain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the chat-completions compatibility holds in practice (e.g., tool-call and streaming parity).
